```{python}
import numpy as np
```

```{python}
a = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
a[0] = 10
a
```

```{python}
a[:3]
```

```{python}
b = a[3:]
print(b)
b[0] = 40
print(f"b: {b}")
print(f"a: {a}")
```
